program_name: Pixel 9 Pro & Pixel 9 Pro XL Extended Repair Program
coverage_summary: Pixel 9 Pro and 9 Pro XL with a bottom-to-top vertical line on the display (or flicker on 9 Pro); free display for 3 years from purchase
watch_phrases: Coverage lasts for 3 years after the original retail-purchase date
Eligibility requires a vertical line on the display
symptom: A vertical line on the display that runs from bottom to top; display flicker on Pixel 9 Pro also qualifies
remedy: Display replacement at no charge, after the repair facility inspects the phone to confirm eligibility
mandatory_conditions: The phone is a Pixel 9 Pro or Pixel 9 Pro XL (check Settings > About phone > Model)
The display shows a vertical line running from bottom to top, or (Pixel 9 Pro) display flicker. Other faults are not part of this program but may be covered by Google's limited warranty
Coverage lasts 3 years after the original retail purchase date
The repair facility inspects the phone first to verify eligibility; you may be asked for proof of ownership
You must be 18 or older, or a parent or guardian must make the request
exclusions_and_caveats: A cracked display or cover glass, or liquid damage, may disqualify the phone, and other damage may have to be paid for
Google says support options may not be available in all countries
Google says flicker qualifies on Pixel 9 Pro devices; for a 9 Pro XL with flicker but no vertical line, confirm with Google
Repairs under the program are warranted for 90 days or the rest of the original warranty, whichever is longer
The program is separate from, and does not restrict, your consumer-law rights in the country where you bought the phone
If you already paid an authorized repair center for this repair before December 8, 2025 and the phone is eligible, Google says you will be notified by email
claim_action: Back up the phone (Settings > System > Backup), then book a repair through Google's repair options, at a Google walk-in center or an authorized repair center. The facility inspects the phone before the free display replacement; have proof of purchase ready.
